description: The pie chart visually segments four key attributes of a reasoning benchmark for large language models (LLMs), each represented by a distinct colored quadrant and associated icon: “Complexity” (yellow, with a ladder icon), “Instance” (light blue, with a shield-and-checkmark icon), “Scalable Oversight” (red, with a checklist icon), and “Coverage” (light green, with a globe-and-gear icon). Each quadrant is labeled with a corresponding descriptor outside the pie — “Auto-verifiable” for Scalable Oversight, “Unhackable” for Instance, and “General” for Coverage — while the Complexity quadrant has a placeholder gray bar, suggesting an incomplete or anonymized label. The chart is divided into four equal 90-degree segments, implying equal weighting or representation of each attribute in the benchmark’s design. The visual layout emphasizes conceptual balance among the four pillars: complexity management, instance integrity, oversight scalability, and general coverage — all framed as critical for evaluating LLMs on NP-hard reasoning tasks.
